scope: Exploratory automated triage and model-selected human review of the same four sampled JRC monthly frames. No independent accuracy certification.

rules.units: Dimensionless product-calibrated BOA reflectance and normalized differences
rules.selection: All 720 frozen public points, all 3022 prepared dates; no target/old-label inputs.
rules.interpretation: Provisional automated screening only. Low-support points remain missing; human review is model-selected and assisted, never independent validation.
